map.FPR 和 FNR 有何不同？: How Do FPR and FNR Differ?
map.FPR=FP/(FP+TN) 是负类误判率；FNR=FN/(FN+TP) 是漏检: FPR=FP/(FP+TN) is the false positive rate for the negative class; FNR=FN/(FN+TP) is the false negative rate. Medical screening usually pushes the FNR down (fewer missed cases), while spam filtering pushes the FPR down (fewer false kills).
map.MCC = (TP·TN − FP·FN)/√[(TP+FP)(TP+FN)(T: MCC = (TP·TN − FP·FN)/√[(TP+FP)(TP+FN)(TN+FP)(TN+FN)]; FPR = FP/(FP+TN); TNR = TN/(FP+TN); FDR = FP/(TP+FP)
map.MCC 取值 [−1,1]，1 为完美、0 为随机、负值为反向相关。: MCC ranges over [−1,1], where 1 is perfect, 0 is random, and a negative value is an inverse correlation.
map.MCC 同时用到混淆矩阵四格，取值 [−1,1]，0 表示与随机猜测相当，在不平: MCC uses all four cells of the confusion matrix and ranges over [−1,1], with 0 meaning no better than random guessing, so it is more robust than accuracy on imbalanced data. FDR answers "how many of the results reported as positive are false positives", complementing precision (P = 1 − FDR), and it is widely used when interpreting corrections for multiple hypothesis tests.

map.为什么准确率高分却不可信？: Why Is a High Accuracy Score Untrustworthy?
map.假正率 FPR=FP/(FP+TN)，衡量负类被误判为正的比例。: False positive rate FPR=FP/(FP+TN) measures the proportion of negatives wrongly judged positive.
map.正负样本极不平衡时全猜负类也能得高准确率。MCC 同时用四类计数，能暴露这种假象: When positive and negative samples are extremely imbalanced, predicting all negatives can still yield high accuracy. MCC uses all four counts at once, exposes this illusion and is a more robust single metric.
map.输入 TP/FP/FN/TN 计算马修斯相关系数 MCC 和 FPR。: Enter TP/FP/FN/TN to compute the Matthews correlation coefficient MCC and the FPR.
map.马修斯相关系数 MCC=(TP·TN−FP·FN)/√((TP+FP)(TP+F: The Matthews correlation coefficient MCC=(TP·TN−FP·FN)/√((TP+FP)(TP+FN)(TN+FP)(TN+FN)) combines all four counts and outperforms accuracy under class imbalance.
